_about: Single source for prompt language. tools/airpg_render.py --plan builds every request from these blocks; docs/visual-design-system.md sections 3 and 8 describe them. Change a block here, never inside a request file. One AI look only: the System AI. There is no Narrator style. Character tokens follow canon revision 3 (2026-11-08): Cordula black on black on grey, Barnaby kraken-scale and dark at rest, never carried.

blocks.card: Cinematic dark-fantasy character card illustration, square, single subject centered with generous margin, waist-up or full body, high contrast, sharp detail, obsidian black and slate grey background with deep Puget Sound teal and sea-glass green, neon magenta-violet System rim light, warm sodium-orange accent light, rainy Pacific Northwest atmosphere, darker edges. Friendly, funny, game-show energy, never menacing, no weapons drawn. Subject:
blocks.floor: Cinematic dark-fantasy digital illustration, wide 16:9 environment scene, no people, no faces, no text, high contrast, obsidian and slate background with deep Puget Sound teal, magenta-violet System glow accents, warm sodium-orange practical lights, rainy Pacific Northwest atmosphere, darker edges. Subject:
blocks.banner: Panoramic cinematic dark-fantasy digital illustration, banner composition, 21:9, dynamic triangular action composition, high contrast, sharp detail on wet neoprene, nylon webbing, octopus skin and calcium shell, obsidian black and slate grey shadows with deep Puget Sound teal and sea-glass green, neon magenta-violet System stage light, warm sodium-orange practical light from below, rainy Pacific Northwest atmosphere, darker edges. Joyful, funny, high-energy dance battle energy, not violence, no weapons drawn. Subject:

model_sheet.CORDULA: Cordula Vance, a Marine Corps Reserve crew chief in her late twenties with dark curly hair, a matte black drysuit, a charcoal tactical float vest and grey webbing, black on black on grey with no orange and no high-visibility color, a sheathed curved karambit knife on the outside of each calf, holding a black touring kayak paddle, no tank on her back
model_sheet.BARNABY: Barnaby, a wild Giant Pacific Octopus bigger than any on record, about 22 feet arm tip to arm tip and about 190 pounds, dark charcoal and slate mottled skin at rest, old scars and barnacle-worn suckers of a wild animal from the Tacoma Narrows, a blackened brass collar with a faint violet glow around his mantle, no human face, not a monster
model_sheet.BARNABY_DANCE: Barnaby, a wild Giant Pacific Octopus bigger than any on record, about 22 feet arm tip to arm tip and about 190 pounds, dark charcoal and slate skin flashing with crimson and white chromatophore light-show patterns as he dances, old scars and barnacle-worn suckers, a blackened brass collar with a faint violet glow around his mantle, no human face, not a monster
model_sheet.GEODUCK: a real Puget Sound geoduck clam: a small pale oblong shell no bigger than a hand, and growing out of it a huge, long, thick, wrinkled tan siphon neck, two feet long and far bigger than the shell, the shell has no face, no eyes, no legs, no arms
model_sheet.LUMPSUCKER: a tiny round green Pacific spiny lumpsucker fish, perfectly round like a golf ball, covered in bumpy tubercles, big black glaring eyes, stubby tiny fins, no long body, no tail stalk, not a seahorse
model_sheet.BARNABY_HARNESS: Barnaby, a huge wild Giant Pacific Octopus with dark charcoal and slate mottled skin and a blackened brass collar with a faint violet glow, wearing a black misting hydration harness on his mantle with fine spray nozzles misting his skin, moving under his own power on his own arms, never carried, no backpack, no water tank, no human face
model_sheet.CADABRA_DRONE: a cheerful boxy cardboard-brown delivery drone with four rotors and a dangling parcel claw, a plain brass-rimmed parcel badge, no letters, no logo, not a real brand
